{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "toKey": "n-1rcac42",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop (event n-58uu1f) triggered the alarm and local complaints, which directly led to Utilities acknowledging receipt and pausing work (event n-1rcac42). The shift log records RHOB reporting at ~10:00 followed by Utilities action at 10:02.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jmeezw", "claim-nhxx37"],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure had not dropped, AL-44 would not have triggered and Utilities likely would not have paused work at that time.",
      "competingExplanation": "No competing explanation; the sequence is linear: drop -> alarm/complaints -> acknowledgment/pause.",
      "evidenceGap": "None for this specific link."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gfn1mr",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 triggering (event n-1gfn1mr) is the system's response to the pressure drop at P-R. The point register maps AL-44 to low-pressure input from P-R, so the physical condition caused the signal.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jmeezw", "claim-nhxx37"],
      "counterfactual": "If pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; the mapping is explicit in IA-P02_point_register.md.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact physical mechanism (sensor failure vs supply loss) remains unknown but does not affect this causal link."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1gqu80",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The condition that the crew may have used an outdated or different version of the equipment-location sheet (DW-1SC-17 Revision A) could enable a misunderstanding about valve states, potentially contributing to why the pressure drop went unnoticed until it triggered alarms. However, this is speculative.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","claim-2x4nrr"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had used a current, accurate location sheet showing valve states and recent changes, they might have detected or prevented the pressure drop earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could be due to upstream supply failure unrelated to any documentation issue; no evidence confirms the document version was incorrect.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need confirmation of which equipment-location sheet revision the crew used and whether it differed from current drawings."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The point register maps AL-44 to receiving-header pressure P-R but does not prove every supply disturbance appears in the sample export. This limitation means a localized valve closure or leak upstream of P-U could cause a drop at P-R without being fully captured, enabling an unnoticed interruption.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the point register covered all relevant valves and disturbances, a localized issue would have been logged differently or earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "The drop could be due to a single upstream event affecting P-R directly; no evidence of multiple disturbance points exists yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need full valve state logs for the distribution system between 09:54 and 10:08."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-uk8heo",
      "toKey": "n-1rcac42",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time. This could enable a lack of specific coordination instructions (e.g., valve isolation steps), contributing to why the pressure drop went unnoticed until it triggered alarms.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the temporary instruction attachment had been completed with specific coordination steps, the crew might have detected or mitigated the pressure drop earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may not be relevant if standard procedures were followed; no evidence of procedure violation exists yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to confirm whether a temporary instruction was required for this work and what it specified."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-15cnyr7",
      "toKey": "n-1rcac42",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The training extract does not state which configuration drawing the crew saw or whether either person received a recent change briefing. This could enable an outdated mental model of valve states, contributing to why the pressure drop went unnoticed.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had received a recent change briefing and used current drawings, they might have detected or prevented the pressure drop earlier.",
      "competingExplanation": "The lack of specific training records does not prove inadequate knowledge; no evidence of actual error exists yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need confirmation of which configuration drawing was in use during maintenance preparation."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14civod",
      "toKey": "n-58uu1f",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time. This could enable an incomplete work boundary release, meaning the crew might have assumed certain valves were isolated when they were not.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","claim-gyysd1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the maintenance acceptance signature had been signed before work began, certain valves might have been confirmed isolated.",
      "competingExplanation": "The unsigned signature may not be relevant if standard procedures were followed; no evidence of procedure violation exists yet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to confirm whether valve isolation was required for this maintenance task and what the acceptance criteria were."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The causal chain is: pressure drop at P-R (n-58uu1f) -> AL-44 alarm triggered (n-1gfn1mr) -> Utilities acknowledged receipt and paused work (n-1rcac42). Several conditions enabled the event to go unnoticed until it triggered alarms, including potential outdated documentation (n-1gqu80), incomplete point register coverage (n-14tzgyz), blank temporary instruction field (n-uk8heo), lack of recent change briefing records (n-15cnyr7), and unsigned maintenance acceptance signature (n-14civod). The exact physical cause of the pressure drop remains unknown.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Exact physical cause of pressure drop at P-R (upstream supply failure, valve closure, leak, etc.)", "Whether crew used outdated equipment-location sheet or current revision", "What specific coordination instructions were required for this maintenance task"],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream compressor trip caused the drop; no evidence yet to confirm.", "A localized valve closure upstream of P-R caused the drop without triggering other alarms."],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request full point register export for all valves in the distribution system between 09:54 and 10:08 to determine if any valve states changed during this period.",
    "Request confirmation of which equipment-location sheet revision (DW-1SC-17) was used by the crew at the time of maintenance preparation."
  ]
}
